# FreeRDP Android CMake fixtures

These two files are byte-for-byte upstream files at
`FreeRDP/FreeRDP@63b948ca5cb94307fd5444ee6e73927a41ccdab4` (3.31.1).
Source: https://github.com/FreeRDP/FreeRDP/tree/63b948ca5cb94307fd5444ee6e73927a41ccdab4/client/Android/cmake

Upstream license: Apache-2.0; see the repository's LICENSE (same license).
The fixtures let patch application tests run offline without the optional
submodule or downloading/building external projects. Do not edit them to make a
patch apply; regenerate from the exact pinned revision if that pin changes.
